fragment.choose:
<when condition="@{
            if (context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contentSafetyPlan", "off") != "on") { return false; }
            var surface = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "model");
            if (!(",{cs-surfaces},").Contains("," + surface + ",")) { return false; }
            if (surface == "tool") { return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName", "") != ""; }
            if (surface == "agent") { return context.Request.Method == "POST"; }
            return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "") != "";
        }">
            
            <set-variable name="safetyText" value="@{
                var surface = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "model");
                var text = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
                JObject body = null;
                try { body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true); } catch { body = null; }
                if (body != null) {
                    if (surface == "tool") {
                        var args = body["params"]?["arguments"];
                        if (args != null) { text.Append(args.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None)); }
                    } else if (surface == "agent") {
                        var parts = body["params"]?["message"]?["parts"] as JArray;
                        if (parts != null) { foreach (var part in parts) { text.Append(part["text"]?.ToString() ?? ""); } }
                    } else {
                        foreach (var key in new [] { "messages", "input" }) {
                            var node = body[key];
                            if (node is JArray items) {
                                foreach (var item in items) {
                                    var content = item is JObject ? item["content"] : item;
                                    if (content is JArray contentParts) {
                                        foreach (var part in contentParts) { text.Append(part["text"]?.ToString() ?? ""); }
                                    } else if (content != null) { text.Append(content.ToString()); }
                                }
                            } else if (node != null) { text.Append(node.ToString()); }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (text.Length == 0) { return context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? ""; }
                return text.ToString();
            }" />
            
            
            
            <set-variable name="safetyCheckedSurface" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "model"))" />
            
                
                    
                    
                    
                    
                
                {cs-blocklists}
            
            {purview-include}
